map: Warehouse 2 (Tacticals match map, GTA-style freight warehouse), brief briefs/map-warehouse2.md
for: roblox-modeler (art/warehouse2/, notes/warehouse2_props.md). Until a piece lands, fix/map_warehouse2.lua builds a Part stand-in at the exact size, tagged Warehouse2Standin (swap list: notes/warehouse2_build.md)
rules: Visual meshes never collide (CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch off): collision stays the invisible COLP_* box of the same size. Cover sizes are fixed by the gameplay layer: a mesh may be up to 0.1 smaller than its box on any side, never bigger. Pivot = bottom centre. Grounded / GTA look: worn, real materials, no neon, no screens, no blue trims, no yellow (hazard = black/cream).
asset_library_start: 02 Modeling/Asset Library: start from the crate / pallet / barrier entries where they exist; stand-in recipes in fix/map_warehouse2.lua (STANDIN table)

pieces.name: JerseyBarrier
pieces.notes: precast concrete, upright profile (top >= 1.0 wide so the box isn't far off), lifting slots, chipped edges, faint grime

pieces.name: PrecastBlockWall
pieces.notes: interlocking concrete blocks (2 wide x 3 high, each ~5x2.33x3), bay divider

pieces.name: TallCrate
pieces.notes: plywood shipping crate on skids, battens, stencil (art/warehouse2/tex/decals), 2 or 3 variants

pieces.name: PalletStack
pieces.notes: two shrink-wrapped pallet loads stacked (each 5x5x5 incl. pallet), cardboard / sacks under wrap

pieces.name: BoxTrailer
pieces.view_distance: 0-60 (from the hall through the door up to 130)
pieces.notes: 40 ft dry van on landing legs, side skirts down to 0.6 so nothing is seen under it, olive stripe livery, two colourways

pieces.name: Container20
pieces.notes: 20 ft ISO container, corrugated sides, door end, two colours (rust red-brown, grey-green)

pieces.name: HighBayLamp

pieces.name: RollUpDoor

pieces.name: FencePanelScreened

pieces.name: Bollard

pieces.name: ElectricalCabinet

pieces.name: OilDrum
